svg.title: Seeded random returns input DataFrame
svg.desc: A 100-row, 2-column DataFrame of seeded random daily returns for SPY and QQQ indexed by business days starting 2 January 2024, with SPY returns scaled by 0.01 and QQQ returns scaled by 0.012 reflecting their different daily volatilities; the seed value of 692 makes every value identical across every test run.
svg.text: returns — 100 business days × 2 tickers, fully reproducible

g.text: rng = np.random.default_rng(692) · same seed every run → identical numbers

svg.text: .shape = (100, 2) · no NaNs anywhere · index = business days, Jan 2 to May 21, 2024
Illustrative values shown; seed 692 produces a specific sequence pandas will reproduce on every run.
